summary: Iteration 27: Validated geospatial + referral-network features on web + shared backend. Backend 6/6 pytest passed (geo/resolve by ZIP & city, invalid origin 400, geo/coverage with filter respected, referral-generators/counts, lead creation with referral_generator_id + filter). Frontend end-to-end on Medicare Search and Referral Search all passed: Miles & Drive-time modes, Leaflet map render (61 paths MS / 50 paths RS, radius circle + origin pin + city pins), Save view/generator persists radius on reload, add-lead from referral row links referral_generator_id, 'X leads' badge updates to '1 leads', clicking opens produced-leads modal with the newly created lead (L-00502). No blocking issues.

design_issues.screen: Any page using a <select> with styled <option>
issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (likely from a select used in ProtectedRoute-rendered page). Occurs on both Medicare Search and Referral Search.

action_items: (Minor) Investigate console warning: a <span> is being rendered inside an <option> somewhere in the app (hydration error). Likely a shadcn Select vs raw <option> mismatch. Not blocking the geospatial/referral features.
critical_code_review_comments: geo.py: _CITY_CENTROID is built at import time from pgeocode's internal _data (uses private attribute _nomi._data). Works today but is fragile across pgeocode upgrades.

routes_crm.py list_leads radius branch loads up to 5000 leads into memory then filters in Python — fine for current volume but should move the (state,city) in-filter into the Mongo query (e.g., build $or using radius_city_filter) for scalability.
CoverageMap uses MapContainer key keyed on origin+radius forcing full remount on every change — acceptable but can flicker; consider using map.setView instead for smoother UX.
ReferralSearch registers a dialog handler via window.prompt for an unnamed save; main flow is fine, but ensure popup blocker / embedded contexts don't swallow the prompt.

seed_data_creation: Created and removed TEST_radius_view saved search; created TEST_Dr_Smith_Cardio referral generator (saved search) and a derived lead L-00502 (Dr. Janelle Duah) — generator removed after test, but lead remains in CRM and is still linked to the (now-deleted) generator id. Main agent may want to script a cleanup for orphan referral_generator_id leads if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration27_geo_referral.py covers the four new backend endpoints and the full referral linkage. Web UI tested at viewport 1920x1080. Only outstanding non-blocking finding is a React hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) emitted on the CRM pages — pre-existing, not caused by the new features.
